result.title: Hit Me Hard and Soft - Wikipedia
result.content: Hit Me Hard and Soft is the third studio album by American singer-songwriter Billie Eilish, released on May 17, 2024, through Darkroom and Interscope Records. She co-wrote it with her brother and frequent collaborator, Finneas O'Connell, who also serves as its producer. Stylistically, it has been labeled an alternative pop and bedroom pop record.

result.content: On July 21, 2022, she surprise-released her second EP, Guitar Songs, which consists of two tracks, "TV" and "The 30th". Her third studio album, Hit Me Hard and Soft, was released on May 17, 2024, and peaked at number two in the US.

### Singles and music videos
[[edit](https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft&action=edit&section=8 "Edit section: Singles and music videos")]
"[Lunch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lunch_\(song\) "Lunch \(song\)")" was released as the lead single in tandem with the album's release, along with a music video directed by Eilish herself.[[58]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-59) The song debuted and peaked at number five on the US [_Billboard_ Hot 100](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Hot_100 "Billboard Hot 100").[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-bbhot100-charthistory-60) It also saw international success, peaking within the top five in the UK,[[60]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-61) Germany,[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-62) Australia and New Zealand,[[62]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-63)[[63]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-64) and various European countries.[[64]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-65)[[65]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-66)[[66]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-67)
An extended version of "[L'Amour de Ma Vie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/L'Amour_de_Ma_Vie "L'Amour de Ma Vie")", subtitled "Over Now", was released as a [promotional single](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Promotional_single "Promotional single") on May 22, 2024.[[67]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-68)
The music video for "[Chihiro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chihiro_\(song\) "Chihiro \(song\)")", also directed by Eilish herself, was released on June 6, 2024.[[68]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-69) The song debuted at number 12 on the _Billboard_ Hot 100 and charted for 20 weeks due to its streaming success, despite not receiving an official single release in the US.[[59]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-bbhot100-charthistory-60) It was sent to Italian radio on January 16, 2025.[[69]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hit_Me_Hard_and_Soft#cite_note-70)
